in_marathi.name: Sharvasvini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Melodies
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvasvini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvasvini is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' and 'Swini'. Sharva is the name of Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism, while Swini refers to a melodious or musical sound. Therefore, the name Sharvasvini can be interpreted as the goddess of melodies or music. In Hindu mythology, Sharada, another form of Saraswati, is often depicted holding a Veena, a musical instrument, which symbolizes knowledge, music, and creativity.
